name: Ibn Khaldun
shortBio: North African polymath, historiographer, and philosopher regarded as the foundational precursor to sociology, demography, and the philosophy of history.
centralQuestion: What cyclical laws of social solidarity and political economy govern the rise, flourishing, and decay of human civilizations?

keyWorks.title: The Muqaddimah (Prolegomena)
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking treatise on historical methodology, political economy, and sociological dynamics of group cohesion.

keyWorks.title: Kitab al-Ibar (Universal History)
keyWorks.description: Comprehensive multivolume universal history of the Arab, Berber, and Mediterranean peoples.
